s: Which one of the following best describes a circular economy?
o: An economic system based primarily on the extraction and disposal of resources
An economic system based on increasing the use of fossil fuels
An economic system built on reuse, recycling and waste minimisation
An economic system focused exclusively on reducing carbon emissions
x: A circular economy is built on reuse, recycling and waste minimisation. It is not exclusively focused on carbon emissions or fossil fuels.
tq: Use the precise definition and reject the extreme word 'exclusively'.
sec: Circular economy - principles, linear vs circular, action plans  [APPSC]

s:
Consider the following statements regarding linear and circular economic models:
1. The linear model follows the sequence ‘take, make, dispose’.
2. In the circular model, materials are kept in use through reduction, reuse, repair and recycling.
3. In the linear model, waste becomes a resource and decouples growth from resource use.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is false because waste becoming a resource and decoupling growth from resource use are features of the circular model.
tq: Compare the defining sequences of the two models and find the reversed feature.

tq: Test the contrast between the linear endpoint and the circular resource approach.
